name: Scattered Photos
description: Photos scattered around a heading at different depths, fading in on mount and shifting with the pointer like near and distant ridges.

props.name: images
props.type: (string | { src: string; alt?: string; x?: number; y?: number; depth?: number; width?: number })[]
props.description: The photos. Plain URLs get a seeded arrangement that keeps the centre clear. In the object form, x and y place the photo's centre as a percentage of the box, depth runs from 0 (far) to 1 (near), and width is in pixels at a 960px-wide box; any field you leave out is filled in from the arrangement. Photos without alt text are treated as decorative.

props.name: strength
props.description: How far the nearest photos move when the pointer reaches an edge, in pixels. Each photo moves by strength × depth.

props.name: variant
props.description: `center-near` puts the near, larger photos closest to the heading; `edge-near` pushes them out to the edges and keeps the far ones inside.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative, clips the photos and is a size container for them. Give it a height. Other div props are passed through.
